description: CNR-ISAC publishes groundwater levels and surface-water-budget terms from the Ecotekne campus in Lecce, Italy. Two historic wells in the Miocene karst aquifer are paired with a nearby micrometeorological station, covering 21 June 2017 through 1 October 2022. The Zenodo release provides text datasets in a ZIP archive freely under CC BY 4.0, including daily and monthly budget estimates used to infer infiltration. These site-specific records can calibrate recharge and groundwater-supply simulations in a Mediterranean setting. Estimated infiltration is model-dependent, the two wells do not represent the entire aquifer, and additional raw half-hour observations require author contact. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Datasets of groundwater level and surface water budget in a central Mediterranean site (June 21, 2017 - October 1, 2022)
